defensiveAbilities.name: Oderless
defensiveAbilities.description: The graul exudes no natural aroma, rendering it undetectable to creatures using the scent ability.

offensiveAbilities.name: Paralysis
offensiveAbilities.description: A living creature struck by a graul's jaws attack must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Paralyzed. It can attempt a new check at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such check. A creature paralyzed by this ability is also affected by the graul's darkvision invisibility for as long as the effect persists.

offensiveAbilities.name: Seize
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The graul has a creature Grabbed with its tentacle

Effect The graul pulls the creature toward itself. The graul attempts an athletics|defense:fortitude check against the creature's Fortitude DC. With a success, the graul pulls the creature 15 feet closer to it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sound Mimicry
offensiveAbilities.description: The graul can perfectly imitate the sounds and speech of other creatures by attempting a deception|against:will check against a listener's Will DC. The graul doesn't need to understand the language it's mimicking, but when speaking a language it doesn't know, the creature can only repeat specific words and phrases it has heard in the past 24 hours. The graul can't use this ability to duplicate voice-based abilities or spells.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tentacle Grab
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature hit by the graul's tentacle becomes Grabbed by the graul. The creature isn't Immobilized, but it can't move beyond the reach of the graul's tentacle. A creature can sever the tentacle with a Strike against AC 18 that deals at least 10 Slashing Damage damage. This deals no damage to the graul but prevents it from using its tentacle Strike until it regrows the tentacle, which takes 1 round. The graul can move without ending the Grab as long as the creature remains within the tentacle's reach.

lv1spells.name: Ventriloquism (At Will)
lv1spells.description:
Whenever you speak or make any other sound vocally, you can make your vocalization seem to originate from somewhere else within 60 feet, and you can change that apparent location freely as you vocalize. Any creature that hears the sound can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The spell's duration increases to 1 hour, and you can also change the tone, quality, and other aspects of your voice. Before a creature can attempt to disbelieve your illusion, it must actively attempt a Perception check or otherwise use actions to interact with the sound.

lv2spells.name: Illusory Object
lv2spells.description:
You create an illusory visual image of a stationary object. The entire image must fit within the spell's area. The object appears to animate naturally, but it doesn't make sounds or generate smells. For example, water would appear to pour down an illusory waterfall, but it would be silent.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the Seek action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) Your image makes appropriate sounds, generates normal smells, and feels right to the touch. The spell gains the auditory trait. The duration increases to 1 hour.

Heightened (5th) As the 2nd-rank version, but the duration is unlimited.
